1.1.02026-11-19

MiseDeck v1.1.0

English · 简体中文

The project's identity release. The app itself is unchanged from 1.0.8 apart from where it checks for updates.

What's in this release

  • New repository name: cherishfall/misedeck → cherishfall/mise-deck. GitHub redirects the old name, so existing links keep working.
  • Update check follows the rename: the in-app manual check and the silent daily check now target the new repository's releases.atom feed directly. Installed clients (1.0.8 and older) keep working through GitHub's redirect of the old feed URL.
  • README: a header banner (the landing-page hero, clickable through to the project page), and the Website section moved to the front of the document.
  • Project page moved: cherishfall.github.io/mise-deck — the old /misedeck/ page path no longer redirects.

No feature, UI, or behavior changes beyond the update-check URL: same eight pages, same mise requirements, same platform support as 1.0.8 (macOS on Apple Silicon polished; Windows x64 exercised end-to-end on one real machine; Linux packaged but not verified on real hardware).

Install

GitHub Releases is the only distribution channel — v1 ships no Homebrew formula or cask (per ADR-0002).

macOS — download the .dmg from the assets below, open it, and drag MiseDeck to Applications.

First launch (unsigned): the binary is not notarized (per ADR-0002). macOS Gatekeeper will block the first open and may report that the app is damaged. After dragging MiseDeck.app to /Applications, remove the quarantine flag from Terminal:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MiseDeck.app

Then launch normally. Subsequent launches work without extra steps.

Windows (beta) — download the .exe installer and run it.

SmartScreen (unsigned): the binary is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen will show "Windows protected your PC" — click More info → Run anyway.

Linux (beta) — pick the package that matches your distro: .deb (Debian / Ubuntu), .rpm (Fedora / RHEL), or .AppImage (portable, no install).

Verify

SHA256SUMS is attached below and lists every asset in this release — run it from the folder you downloaded into.

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

# Linux
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

# Windows (PowerShell) — one file at a time
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\MiseDeck_1.1.0_x64-setup.exe

This catches a truncated download, a proxy that served the wrong file, or an asset replaced after upload. It does not prove who built the binary — the builds are unsigned (see Notes).

Notes

  • MiseDeck v1 is distributed unsigned on every platform, by design. Code signing and Apple notarization are out of scope for v1.
  • Windows and Linux builds are labeled beta in this release.
  • MiseDeck is a community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the official mise project.

本次是项目身份的更新。应用本身与 1.0.8 一致，只有检查更新的地址变了。

本版内容

  • 仓库更名：cherishfall/misedeck → cherishfall/mise-deck。GitHub 会对旧名重定向，已有链接不受影响。
  • 检查更新跟随更名：应用内的手动检查更新与每日静默检查，现在直接指向新仓库的 releases.atom feed。已安装的旧版本（1.0.8 及更早）经 GitHub 对旧地址的重定向照常工作。
  • README：新增头图（落地页首屏，点击跳转项目页），「站点」一节移到文档前部。
  • 项目页迁移：cherishfall.github.io/mise-deck —— 旧的 /misedeck/ 页面路径不再重定向。

除检查更新地址外没有任何功能、界面或行为改动：八个页面、mise 版本要求、平台支持都与 1.0.8 相同（macOS Apple Silicon 打磨完成；Windows x64 已在一台真实机器上完整走通；Linux 有包但未在真机验证）。

安装

GitHub Releases 是唯一分发渠道——v1 不提供 Homebrew formula 或 cask（见 ADR-0002）。

macOS —— 从下方资产下载 .dmg，打开并把 MiseDeck 拖进「应用程序」。

首次启动（未签名）：二进制未经公证（见 ADR-0002）。macOS Gatekeeper 会拦下第一次打开，并可能提示应用「已损坏」。把 MiseDeck.app 拖进 /Applications 后，在终端执行：

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MiseDeck.app

然后正常打开。之后的启动无需额外步骤。

Windows（beta） —— 下载 .exe 安装包并运行。

SmartScreen（未签名）：二进制未经代码签名。Windows SmartScreen 会显示「已保护你的电脑」——点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。

Linux（beta） —— 选择匹配发行版的包：.deb（Debian / Ubuntu）、.rpm（Fedora / RHEL）或 .AppImage（免安装）。

校验

下方附有 SHA256SUMS，覆盖本发布的全部资产——在你下载的目录里运行：

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

# Linux
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

# Windows (PowerShell) —— 逐个文件
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\MiseDeck_1.1.0_x64-setup.exe

它能发现被截断的下载、代发了错误文件的代理、或上传后被替换的资产。它不能证明二进制是谁构建的——构建未签名（见说明）。

说明

  • MiseDeck v1 在所有平台有意未签名分发。代码签名与 Apple 公证不在 v1 范围内。
  • 本发布中 Windows 与 Linux 构建标注为 beta。
  • MiseDeck 是社区项目，与官方 mise 项目无隶属或背书关系。

1.0.82026-11-18

A re-audit patch: the second review round's fixes, shipped so the next release inherits them.

Changed

  • The registry search's failure card reads "Could not load search suggestions" — the title no longer uses a word the glossary retires from user-facing copy.
  • package.json's version metadata is 1.0.7 (the v1.0.7 tag carried a malformed string there; the app itself was always 1.0.7 — no behavior changed).

For maintainers

  • The release template now ships both language halves, so a lightweight tag's notes are bilingual by default (v1.0.7's shipped English-only; these notes are hand-written bilingual).
  • Docs: the developer READMEs' check list renumbers 1–21; ci.md no longer claims Vite injects package.json's version.

复审补丁：把第二轮复审的修复随版发布。

变更

  • registry 搜索的失败卡片标题改为「无法加载搜索建议」——不再使用术语表从 UI 文案退役的词。
  • package.json 的版本元数据修正为 1.0.7（v1.0.7 的 tag 里曾是一个畸形字符串；应用本身一直是 1.0.7——行为无变化）。

给维护者

  • 发布模板现在带两个语言半段，轻量 tag 的发布说明默认双语（v1.0.7 发布的是纯英文；本发布说明为手写双语）。
  • 文档：开发者 README 的检查清单重新编号为 1–21；ci.md 不再声称 Vite 会注入 package.json 的版本。

1.0.72026-11-18

A patch release from the round-7 audit — a fresh, comprehensive review of the shipped app, the docs, the site, and the release layer.

Fixed

  • The Settings page's "Show all" view no longer renders the literal text "undefined" for settings without a value — it shows the empty-value placeholder instead.
  • A failed mise registry --json read in the Tools page's version-management search renders a failure card with a retry, instead of reading as "no matches".
  • The Home page's timeout card keeps the failure detail and a retry, like its sibling failure cards.
  • On Windows, cancelling, timing out, or quitting no longer flashes a console window: the process-tree killer's taskkill spawn hides its window like every other spawn.
  • Confirm dialogs announce their consequence sentence to screen readers (aria-describedby), not just their title.

For maintainers

  • The macOS CI leg no longer fails on open -a Terminal: on hosted runners the terminal test now pins what the app actually guarantees — a keyed failure carrying the resolved path — instead of assuming a GUI session can launch Terminal.
  • Three child-spawning tests in tests/runner.rs had missed the #278 serialize-everything rule; they carry #[serial] now.
  • The channel kinds the execution panel pattern-matches on (stdout / stderr / exit) are pinned in the wire-shape test like every other boundary enum.
  • Docs: AGENTS.md now prescribes a gh field that exists (blockedBy); the developer READMEs list all 21 npm run ci steps; ADR-0001's consequence carries a dated status note; the fonts README gained its zh-CN mirror.

来自第 7 轮审计的补丁版本——对已发布的应用、文档、站点与发布层的一次全新全面复审。

修复

  • 设置页「显示全部」视图不再为没有值的设置项渲染字面量 "undefined"，改为显示空值占位符。
  • 工具页版本管理搜索里，mise registry --json 读取失败现在渲染带重试的失败卡片，而不是表现成「没有匹配」。
  • 首页的超时卡片保留失败详情与重试，与同页其他失败卡片一致。
  • 在 Windows 上，取消、超时或退出不再闪出控制台窗口：进程树终止的 taskkill spawn 与其他所有 spawn 一样隐藏自己的窗口。
  • 确认对话框向屏幕阅读器播报后果句子（aria-describedby），而不只是标题。

给维护者

  • macOS CI 腿不再因 open -a Terminal 失败：在托管 runner 上，终端测试改为断言应用真正保证的东西——带已解析路径的键控失败——而不是假定 GUI 会话能启动终端。
  • tests/runner.rs 三个会 spawn 子进程的测试漏掉了 #278 的串行化规则，现在带上 #[serial]。
  • 执行面板按其匹配的 channel kind（stdout / stderr / exit）现在像其他所有边界枚举一样在 wire-shape 测试里钉死。
  • 文档：AGENTS.md 规定的 gh 字段改为真实存在的（blockedBy）；开发者 README 列全 21 步 npm run ci；ADR-0001 的后果段带上日期状态注；fonts README 补上 zh-CN 镜像。

1.0.62026-11-18

A patch release that closes the last review round.

Fixed

  • A cancelled run is now reported as cancelled on every path. The install runner had its own cancellation message, so the panel settled it as a failure whose body said the installer was cancelled — a card that contradicted itself.
  • A failure with no output says what went wrong instead of showing an empty log: the panel now renders the failure detail it was already carrying.
  • The release feed's size limit reads "1 MiB" rather than a raw byte count.
  • The Chinese sentences no longer carry a stray space between two Han characters, and a lint keeps them that way.
  • The Home page shows the parse-failure detail it knows — the command and the shape it expected — instead of speculating that you might be running a forked build.

For maintainers

  • Clippy runs on the Windows and macOS legs too, and macOS runs the Rust test suite: the polished platform now has runtime assertions of its own. Both new legs earned their place immediately — they caught a lint that only exists on the Windows path and a macOS test that assumed a terminal can launch without a GUI session.
  • The site's changelog generator splits on every language marker, renders tables and shell snippets as code, and refuses to publish a commit message or a dead Homebrew command as release notes.
  • The thirteen releases whose published notes were raw commit messages now carry proper bilingual notes.

一个收尾最后一轮复审的补丁版本。

修复

  • 被取消的运行现在在所有路径上都判定为已取消。安装 runner 原先有自己的取消信息，于是面板把它判成失败，正文却写着安装程序已取消——一张自相矛盾的卡片。
  • 没有输出的失败会说明发生了什么，而不是留一段空日志：面板现在会渲染它本就持有的失败详情。
  • 发布源的大小上限读作「1 MiB」，而不是原始字节数。
  • 中文句子不再在两个汉字之间留下多余空格，并有守卫守着。
  • 首页会显示它确实知道的解析失败详情——执行过的命令与预期的结构——而不是猜测你可能跑的是某个分支版本。

给维护者

  • clippy 现在也在 Windows 与 macOS 腿上跑，macOS 腿会跑 Rust 测试套件：打磨目标平台第一次有了自己的运行时断言。两条新腿立刻证明了自己的价值——它们抓到一条只在 Windows 路径存在的 lint，以及一个假定无 GUI 会话也能启动终端的 macOS 测试。
  • 站点的更新日志生成器按每一个语言标记切分，把表格与 shell 片段按代码块渲染，并拒绝把提交信息或失效的 Homebrew 命令当发布说明发布。
  • 十三个曾以原始提交信息作为发布说明的版本，现在都带上了真正的双语说明。

1.0.52026-11-18

A patch release that closes the last review round.

Fixed

  • MiseDeck's own error messages are localized: a payload MiseDeck could not parse, or a command that failed, no longer shows an English sentence in the Chinese UI. Every message MiseDeck authors now carries a key, the command it ran, and the shape it expected. mise's own output still appears exactly as the CLI printed it.
  • The message the runner reports when a run is cancelled is now the same shared, key-shaped value on both sides of the boundary, so the two can no longer drift apart.
  • Parameters in a message are percent-encoded, so a path or an argument can no longer split a message into parts that were never meant to be read separately.

Site

  • The release history no longer republishes a Homebrew command that cannot work, and it refuses to publish one.
  • Shell snippets in the release notes render as code blocks, not as headings that were only comments.
  • The FAQ names both of the app's outbound requests: the manual check, and the silent one that runs at most once a day.

一个收尾最后一轮复审的补丁版本。

修复

  • MiseDeck 自己的错误信息已本地化：解析不了的内容、或执行失败的命令，不再在中文界面上显示英文句子。MiseDeck 自己写的每条信息现在都带一个键、它执行过的命令，以及它预期的结构；mise 自己的输出仍按 CLI 打印的原样呈现。
  • 运行被取消时上报的信息，现在在边界两侧共用同一个带键的值，两边不会再各说各话。
  • 信息中的参数做了百分号编码，路径或参数不再能把一条信息拆成本不该被拆开的几段。

站点

  • 发布历史不再复现跑不通的 Homebrew 命令，并且拒绝发布这类命令。
  • 发布说明里的 shell 片段按代码块渲染，不再变成只是注释的标题。
  • 常见问题里如实说明应用仅有的两个对外请求：手动检查，以及每天至多一次的静默检查。

1.0.42026-11-18

A patch release that closes the post-release review of 1.0.3.

Fixed

  • The public site's changelog no longer labels a bilingual release as English-only: the language split now finds its marker wherever the body puts it, so v1.0.1's h1-style bilingual notes split correctly.
  • The historical brew install --cask cherishfall/tap/misedeck line is gone from the changelog — v1 ships no tap, so the page no longer offers a command that cannot work. The generator now refuses to emit one.

  • The documented count of backend commands is 23, and it names the one command that has never run on real Windows hardware.

Docs

  • The release-notes template is documented as the default path for routine releases, with the site rules that follow from it.

一个收尾 1.0.3 发版后复审的补丁版本。

修复

  • 公开站点的更新日志不再把双语发布误标为「只有英文」：语言切分现在按正文实际出现的位置识别标记，v1.0.1 那种 h1 标题的双语说明能正确切分。
  • 更新日志里指向从未存在的 tap 的历史 brew install --cask cherishfall/tap/misedeck 已移除——v1 不提供 tap，站点不会再给出跑不通的命令；生成器也会拒绝输出这类命令。

  • 文档中的后端命令数量改为 23，并注明其中哪一条从未在真实 Windows 硬件上跑过。

文档

  • 发布说明模板被记录为常规发布的默认路径，以及由此产生的站点规则。

1.0.32026-11-18

A patch release that closes the 1.0.2 final review.

Fixed

  • The Tools remote-version list is no longer truncated: the execution-panel read path now captures the whole payload, so mise ls-remote --json resolves for tools whose version list exceeds a single line (node, python, go).
  • Reads of a trusted directory no longer lose the project's environment variables: MISE_SAFE is now applied only where it is needed — an untrusted directory — and the doctor report is no longer polluted by it.
  • The version-management failure card names the command that actually failed (mise ls-remote --json <tool>) and shows the error detail instead of borrowing the version-probe copy.
  • The write-scope check survives symlinked directory prefixes, so a variable defined in the active directory's own config is no longer classed as a parent's — and Unset is enabled again where it belongs.
  • The "opened in terminal" hint stays on screen for its full four seconds, and a locale switch rewrites it in place instead of clearing or stranding it.
  • A cancel that races its own acknowledgment settles the run as cancelled instead of failed.
  • The captured-read size cap no longer retries through the plain-text fallback, and its detail is localized.

Aligned with the design rules

  • Badge casing, page-title case, and placeholder style are consistent across the UI.
  • Table row dividers use the neutral border token instead of an accent tint.
  • Only destructive confirmations carry the destructive accent.
  • The empty states of Tools, Env, Plugins, and Overview carry their own next step; the five pages that need mise now name their own subject.
  • The Linux desktop entry is categorized, the Windows installer mode is pinned, and the documentation counts what was actually verified.

一个收尾 1.0.2 全面审查的补丁版本。

修复

  • 工具页的远程版本列表不再被截断：执行面板的读取路径改为捕获完整负载，mise ls-remote --json 在版本列表超过一行的工具（node、python、go）上不再解析失败。
  • 受信任目录的读取不再丢失项目自身的环境变量：MISE_SAFE 只在真正需要的地方生效（未受信任的目录），诊断报告也不再被它污染。
  • 版本管理区的失败卡会指明真正失败的那条命令（mise ls-remote --json <tool>），并显示错误细节，而不是借用版本探测的文案。
  • 写作用域判断在符号链接目录前缀下依然正确：定义在当前目录自身配置里的变量不再被归为「父目录」，Unset 也恢复可用。
  • 「在终端中打开」的提示会完整显示四秒；切换语言时就地改写，不再被清除或遗留。
  • 与自身取消回执竞速的运行会判定为已取消，而不是失败。
  • 捕获读取的大小上限不再触发明文回退，其错误细节也已本地化。

对齐设计规则

  • 徽标大小写、页面标题大写、占位符风格在全应用统一。
  • 表格行分隔线改用中性边框色，不再带品牌色偏。
  • 只有破坏性确认才使用警示色。
  • 工具、环境变量、插件、概览四页的空态各自带上下一步入口；缺 mise 时，五个页面各自说明自己的主体。
  • Linux 桌面条目补上分类，Windows 安装模式显式固定，文档中的数字改为实际验证过的口径。

1.0.22026-10-26

MiseDeck 1.0.2 — post-1.0.1 audit patch (2026-10-26)

Fixes

  • Tools: mise ls-remote --json is no longer truncated at 8 KiB per line, so long remote version lists arrive complete (#282).
  • All configuration-dependent views — tools, env, tasks, plugins, settings — refresh after a write, including lockfile and activation state (#285).
  • Execution panel: a run settles from the command's real exit code and duration; the newest tool row is no longer duplicated; switching language no longer re-probes the shell (#286).
  • Rust: read commands are bounded like writes, the launch probe no longer blocks the UI thread, and a mise candidate must be executable to be used (#283); the registry fallback is narrower, curl/sh resolve to absolute paths, pre-release versions parse, the exit sweep runs twice, and a redundant opener scope is gone (#289).
  • Windows: process-tree teardown no longer waits for taskkill while holding the registry lock (#284).
  • Frontend: the inline theme bootstrap moved out of index.html so the release CSP holds; stuck open-outcome hints clear; table sorting and column widths are stable; duplicate ls-remote dispatches collapse (#290).
  • npm run tauri dev starts again — multiple binaries are disambiguated by default-run, and a new lint guard keeps it that way.

Tests and CI

  • cargo fmt gate, macOS Rust compilation before a release, and one frontend check set shared by every leg (#287).
  • Render-level wiring tests for ConfirmDialog and the execution panel (#291).

Docs

  • Invocation routing links ADR-0005 instead of restating it; the Use / Active vocabulary is unified (#288).

Installers

Builds are unsigned: macOS needs the Gatekeeper step, Windows may show SmartScreen, and Linux packages carry no GPG signature. Verify every asset with the release's SHA256SUMS; instructions are in the README — https://github.com/cherishfall/mise-deck#readme

修复

  • 工具页：mise ls-remote --json 不再被单行 8 KiB 截断，较长的远程版本列表可以完整到达（#282）。
  • 所有依赖配置的视图——工具、环境变量、任务、插件、设置——在写操作后都会刷新，覆盖锁文件与激活状态（#285）。
  • 执行面板：运行按命令的真实退出码与耗时结束；最新工具行不再重复；切换语言不再重新探测 shell（#286）。

测试与 CI

  • 加入 cargo fmt 关卡、发版前编译 macOS Rust 代码、所有腿共用一个前端检查集（#287）。

文档

安装包

构建未签名：macOS 需走 Gatekeeper 步骤，Windows 可能显示 SmartScreen，Linux 包没有 GPG 签名。请用本次 release 的 SHA256SUMS 校验全部资产；说明见 README —— https://github.com/cherishfall/mise-deck#readme

1.0.12026-10-24

MiseDeck v1.0.1

English · 简体中文

MiseDeck 1.0.1 — the first patch after 1.0.0.

Most of this release is the post-GA audit batch. The items under "From a real install" are the three that only showed up after 1.0.0 was actually installed and used on a Windows 11 machine, which is what this patch is mostly about.

Fixed in 1.0.1

From a real install

  • A release build can no longer package a test fixture instead of the app. tauri build compiles with cargo build --bins and then packages "the" app binary; with the app and two test harnesses in the same package it picked a harness, producing a 262 KB installer that printed no fixture for slug and exited 0. Neither mainBinaryName nor -- --bin misedeck steered it. The harnesses now sit behind a fixtures feature, so a release build contains exactly one binary. (The released 1.0.0 installer was never affected — 2.7 MB — but nothing stopped CI.)
  • The activation banner names the PowerShell you actually have. It always pointed at pwsh 7's Documents/PowerShell/…, so on a machine with only Windows PowerShell 5.1 — which reads Documents/WindowsPowerShell/… and never opens that file — the instruction could not be followed. The prompt now follows where pwsh.exe; both profiles stay in the candidate list.
  • The Home page's update dialog no longer prints -C $HOME. It read mise -C $HOME self-update --yes, which is the runner's internal anchor, not something anyone types. It now shows mise self-update --yes with the same "Working directory: ~ (home)" line every other command gets.
  • The Home page's raw output block prints its label once, not twice. The block that the disclosure reveals is now a role="region" named by its own trigger.

Correctness

  • Tasks: inline editing is gated to lossless, in-scope tasks.
  • Env: parent configs no longer leak into directory-scoped writes; trust parsing hardened.
  • Tools: a version that was requested but is missing shows as missing instead of being papered over; remote lists refresh.
  • Data: wrong-shaped read payloads are rejected and surfaced instead of rendering as a healthy-looking blank screen.
  • Overview preview: parent configs are distinguishable from Global.
  • Plugins: installed plugins show their ref and commit.
  • Reads dispatched from the execution panel run with MISE_SAFE.
  • Streaming output is capped with a typed truncation event; Windows shell detection fixed.
  • Layout: Tasks and Settings tables stay usable at 900×600 and 1200×720.
  • Settings: "Show all" lists defaults in Directory mode.

Keyboard and dialogs

  • Escape now reaches a confirm dialog nested inside the form that opened it.
  • A bundle of keyboard and control-state polish: focus rings, tooltip tab stops, disabled-state contrast, nested interactives.

Under the hood

  • The line reader retries an interrupted read instead of treating EINTR as end of input — a path that dropped the pipe's read end, SIGPIPE'd the child, and reported exited with status -1.
  • terminate_all can no longer kill a neighbouring test's child process; tests that can see the process-global registry are serialized.
  • CI: least-privilege workflow permissions, SHA-pinned actions, a clippy -D warnings gate, and a failure digest that names the failing test.
  • Release notes for lightweight tags render the curated template instead of the commit message.

Install

GitHub Releases is the only distribution channel (per ADR-0002).

  • macOS (Apple Silicon): download the .dmg, open it, drag MiseDeck to Applications. The build is not notarized — after installing, clear the quarantine flag once: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MiseDeck.app.
  • Windows x64 (beta): run the .exe. It installs per-user into %LOCALAPPDATA% with no administrator rights; uninstall from Settings → Apps. The build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" — More info → Run anyway.
  • Linux (beta): .deb, .rpm, or .AppImage. Built against Ubuntu 22.04; needs WebKitGTK 2.40+.

Verify

SHA256SUMS is attached below and lists every asset in this release. Run it from the folder you downloaded into:

shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS    # macOS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS        # Linux

On Windows, hash one file at a time: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\MiseDeck_1.0.1_x64-setup.exe.

Notes

  • Builds are unsigned on every platform, by design. Windows and Linux remain beta: Windows has been exercised end-to-end on one real machine (and its installer now installed there), Linux has not been run on a real desktop yet.
  • Update checks shell out to curl, which ignores the Windows system proxy — set https_proxy on a machine that reaches GitHub only through one.
  • MiseDeck is a community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the official mise project.

MiseDeck 1.0.1

1.0.0 之后的第一个补丁版本。主体是发版后审计修掉的正确性问题，而「真机安装后才暴露」的那三项是这一版的重点。

本次更新

真机安装后暴露的问题

  • 打包不会再拿测试 fixture 当应用。 tauri build 用 cargo build --bins 编译后要打包「那个」应用二进制；同一个包里还有两个测试 harness 时它会挑错，产出 262 KB、运行只打印 no fixture for slug 的安装包。mainBinaryName 与 -- --bin misedeck 都管不住它。现在两个 harness 由 fixtures 特性门控，release 构建里只剩一个二进制。（正式发布的 1.0.0 安装包没有中招，但 CI 也没有任何东西拦着它。）
  • 激活提示会指向你真正装着的那个 PowerShell。 之前无条件指向 pwsh 7 的 Documents/PowerShell/…；只装了 Windows PowerShell 5.1 的机器读的是 Documents/WindowsPowerShell/…，那个文件根本不会被打开，照做也没用。现在由 where pwsh.exe 决定报哪一个，两个 profile 仍在候选里。
  • 首页更新弹窗不再打印 -C $HOME。 之前显示 mise -C $HOME self-update --yes——那是 runner 内部锚定，不是人在终端里会敲的命令。现在显示 mise self-update --yes，并和其余命令一样带「运行目录：~（主目录）」这一行。
  • 首页原始输出展开后不再重复标签。 展开的内容改成 role="region"，由触发按钮命名。

正确性

  • 任务页：内联编辑只对无损、作用域正确的任务开放。
  • 环境变量页：父级配置不再泄漏进目录作用域的写入；trust 解析加固。
  • 工具页：请求了但缺失的版本如实显示为缺失；远程列表可刷新。
  • 数据层：结构不对的读取负载会被拒绝并报错，而不是渲染成「看起来正常」的空页。
  • 概览预览：父级配置与全局不再混淆。
  • 插件页：显示插件的 ref 与 commit。
  • 执行面板发起的读取走 MISE_SAFE。
  • 流式输出加上限并带类型化截断事件；修正 Windows shell 探测。
  • 布局：Tasks / Settings 表格在 900×600 与 1200×720 下仍可用。
  • 设置页：「显示全部」在目录模式下也会列出默认值。

键盘与弹窗

  • Esc 现在能到达嵌套在表单里的确认弹窗。
  • 一批键盘与控件状态打磨：焦点环、Tooltip 的 tab 停靠、禁用态对比度、嵌套交互。

底层

  • 行读取线程遇到被中断的读取会重试，而不是当成输入结束——那条路径会关掉管道读端、让子进程吃 SIGPIPE，最终报 exited with status -1。
  • terminate_all 不会再误杀邻居测试的子进程；能看见进程级全局注册表的测试已串行化。
  • CI：最小权限、action 按 SHA 固定、clippy -D warnings 门禁、失败摘要直接点出失败的测试名。
  • lightweight tag 也会渲染整理好的发布说明模板，而不是直接拿提交信息当正文。

安装

  • macOS（Apple Silicon）：下载 .dmg，打开后把 MiseDeck 拖进「应用程序」。构建未公证，装好后执行一次 xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MiseDeck.app。
  • Windows x64（beta）：运行 .exe，按用户装进 %LOCALAPPDATA%，不需要管理员权限；卸载走「设置 → 应用」。构建未签名，SmartScreen 会拦一次：更多信息 → 仍要运行。
  • Linux（beta）：.deb / .rpm / .AppImage。以 Ubuntu 22.04 为构建基准，需要 WebKitGTK 2.40+。

校验

本 release 附带 SHA256SUMS，覆盖全部资产；在下好包的目录里执行 shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS（macOS）或 sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS（Linux）。Windows 上逐个文件核对：Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\MiseDeck_1.0.1_x64-setup.exe。

说明

  • 各平台构建均未签名，这是既定方案。Windows 与 Linux 仍标为 beta：Windows 已在一台真机上完整走通、安装包也已在该机器上安装，Linux 尚未在真实桌面运行过。
  • 更新检查走 curl，不读 Windows 系统代理——只能靠代理访问 GitHub 的机器请设置 https_proxy。
  • MiseDeck 是社区项目，与官方 mise 项目无隶属关系。

1.0.02026-10-21

The first stable release of MiseDeck: eight pages, each one a part of the mise CLI.

What's in it

  • Home — version gate, guided install when mise is missing, one-click self-update.
  • Tools — installed and active tools; install, switch, upgrade, and outdated badges in one table.
  • Overview — resolved tools, env vars, config files in precedence order, and mise.lock, every row labeled with its source.
  • Env — add, edit, rename, and unset environment variables, with source badges.
  • Tasks — list, run with live output, create, and edit.
  • Settings — view, filter, edit, and unset settings, including --all.
  • Doctor — status, shell activation, warnings, config files, and the resolved toolset.
  • Plugins — installed plugins, install from a git URL, uninstall.

Beyond the pages: the execution panel (the exact command, live logs, the exit code, copy-command, cancel), read-only untrusted directories with one-click mise trust, terminal and activation helpers, light and dark themes, and an English / Simplified Chinese UI.

GitHub Releases is the only distribution channel — v1 ships no Homebrew formula or cask.

MiseDeck 的第一个稳定版：八个页面，每个对应 mise 命令行的一部分。

包含什么

  • 首页——版本门禁、缺 mise 时的引导安装、一键自更新。
  • 工具——已安装与已激活的工具；一张表里完成安装、切换、升级与过时标记。
  • 概览——解析出的工具与环境变量、按优先级排列的配置文件，以及 mise.lock，每一行都标注来源。
  • 环境变量——增删改环境变量，带来源徽标。
  • 任务——列出、实时运行、创建与编辑。
  • 设置——查看、筛选、修改与取消设置，支持 --all。
  • 诊断——状态、shell 激活、警告、配置文件与解析出的工具集。
  • 插件——已安装插件、从 git 地址安装、卸载。

页面之外还有：执行面板（确切的命令行、实时日志、退出码、复制命令、取消）、未受信任目录只读并可一键 mise trust、终端与激活助手、浅色与深色主题，以及英文 / 简体中文界面。

唯一的分发渠道是 GitHub Releases——v1 不提供 Homebrew formula 或 cask。

1.0.0-beta.17预发布Pre-release2026-10-21

The last pre-release before v1.0.0. It closes the two things a new user notices first: the app now shows its own version, and the update check never leaves the app.

What's new

  • The app's own version is finally visible. A quiet colophon line sits at the bottom of the sidebar, one size smaller than mise's version on the pages, and it opens a small panel: MiseDeck's version, a manual update check, and the Release page. Collapsing the sidebar to the icon rail keeps it reachable.
  • Check for MiseDeck updates without leaving the app. Manual only — nothing runs at launch. Bounded at 8 seconds, goes through your system proxy, and on success or failure says one sentence and offers one next step. It never downloads or installs a build; the last stop is the Release page, where your browser takes over.

Fixed

  • Fonts that never loaded. The app shipped a CSP of default-src 'self', which silently blocked the Google Fonts links, so every build until now rendered in fallback system fonts. All three families are now self-hosted.
  • External links did nothing. The Release page, the mise docs and the download link were plain target="_blank" anchors, and a webview does not open windows it was not asked to open — the click was dropped. Links now go through a Rust command that validates the scheme (http / https only) and hands the URL to the system browser.
  • "Open in editor" was denied by the app's own capability config. The path opener was granted without a scope, and an empty scope means "nothing is allowed", so the menu item could only ever produce an error.

Also

  • The macOS app icon was rescaled to a safe area, so it no longer renders larger than every other app in the Dock.
  • SHA256SUMS now ships with every release, covering all five packages.

v1.0.0 之前的最后一个预发布版。它收尾了新用户最先注意到的两件事：应用终于显示自己的版本号，更新检查也不离开应用。

新增

  • 应用自己的版本号终于可见。 侧栏底部有一行安静的版本信息，比页面上的 mise 版本号小一号，点开是一个小面板：MiseDeck 的版本、手动更新检查、发布页。侧栏收起成图标轨道后依然可以点到。
  • 在应用内检查 MiseDeck 更新。 仅手动触发——启动时不做任何事。最长 8 秒，走系统代理，成功或失败都只说一句并给出一个下一步。它从不下载或安装构建产物；终点是发布页，之后交给浏览器。

修复

  • 字体一直加载不出来。 应用使用 default-src 'self' 的 CSP，悄悄挡掉了 Google Fonts 链接，所以此前的每个构建都退回系统字体。现在三个字族全部自托管。
  • 外部链接点了没反应。 发布页、mise 文档与下载链接原本是普通的 target="_blank" 锚点，而 webview 不会打开它没被要求打开的窗口——点击被丢弃。现在链接经由一条 Rust 命令，校验协议（仅 http / https）后交给系统浏览器。
  • 「在编辑器中打开」被应用自己的能力配置拒绝。 路径打开器没有配置范围，而空范围意味着「什么都不允许」，所以这个菜单项只能报错。

另外

  • macOS 应用图标按安全区重新缩放，不再在 Dock 里显得比别人大一圈。
  • 每个发布都附带 SHA256SUMS，覆盖全部五个安装包。

1.0.0-beta.16预发布Pre-release2026-10-20

这次发布的说明未能按语言拆分，下面是原文。These release notes could not be split by language; the original text follows.

MiseDeck v1.0.0-beta.16

Fifteenth build since August 2026. This release ships the two pre-release audit batches closed since beta.14: the beta15 remediation and the beta16 deep audit, all verified on real builds (8 pages × en/zh, light/dark, global/directory, plus failure simulations).

Reads no longer lie

  • A non-zero mise exit is a failure at the command boundary: install / use / unuse / uninstall / settings set / plugins / tasks mutations no longer show a green success bar, invalidate caches, or clear forms on failure.
  • The Doctor page no longer fabricates a healthy report from zero data when mise is broken: a zero-line report on a non-zero exit is a failure, shown with stderr and a retry.
  • Created dates in the remote-version table are real (created_at field fix); date-fragment filtering works.
  • "Update available" no longer appears when the target equals the current version, and such rows no longer count toward "N tools outdated".
  • Tools with no config-file source render — / Orphan instead of a fabricated Global; Tools and Preview agree.

Process lifecycle

  • Streamed output has a bounded reader shutdown: the execution panel no longer hangs forever when a grandchild process holds stdout, and one invalid UTF-8 byte can no longer truncate the transcript.
  • Every child runs in its own process group: cancel and quit terminate the whole tree (unix killpg, Windows taskkill /F /T), not just the direct child.

Layout, tables, focus

  • All 8 pages share one content baseline; empty tables no longer render a floating header band; empty states carry in-card actions.
  • Version cells render as full-contrast text instead of inheriting disabled-control tint; table headers and data share one padding baseline.
  • Path columns use measured character budgets with head elision, so GOBIN / GOROOT / JAVA_HOME and global-vs-project config paths stay distinguishable.
  • Dialogs open with a safe initial focus target and trap Tab while open; tooltips expand on focus.

Copy

  • The self-invented "scope / 作用域" vocabulary is retired app-wide.
  • The plugin URL placeholder is fully visible; Preview env values match Env's emphasis; command hints never break with an orphaned ·.
  • Source badges are neutral — a tool-provided variable no longer wears warning gold.

Platform & safety

  • mise resolution probes well-known locations plus every PATH entry, with Windows .exe install locations; CI runs a windows-latest job.
  • Every directory-scoped command validates its cwd; the lockfile is read off the main thread; MISE_SAFE=1 is enforced; the unused opener capability was removed.

Known limitations

  • Windows is experimental: CI compiles and unit-tests it, but no real-machine verification yet. Linux is packaged but unverified. macOS on Apple Silicon remains the polished target.
  • Click-driven flows (dialogs, directory picker, mutations, run panel) were verified at the boundary level (tests + failure simulations); a final hands-on pass remains.

1.0.0-beta.14预发布Pre-release2026-09-22

Two review waves closed. The directory picker speaks one language now, the Tools page's advanced section is a panel instead of a floating form, and the execution panel's header finally behaves the way the rules describe.

Fixed

  • The directory picker says one thing. "Choose directory" everywhere it appears, in both languages.
  • The Tools page's advanced section is a real panel. The trigger sits in the panel's header row, and the content fills the panel's width.
  • The execution panel header was rebuilt. Dismiss is always rendered and always rightmost; Cancel became a secondary button (cancelling is routine, not destructive); the panel can never be closed while it runs.
  • A StrictMode double-mount left the run-lock stuck. Every confirm dialog in the app was disabled after a hot reload.
  • The outdated hint had three states where it needed four. It now shows loading, outdated, up to date, and failed-with-retry — a failed check no longer renders as "still checking".
  • The Env and Settings pages repeated what the top strip already said. Their scope badges are gone; the strip is the one place a directory context appears.

两轮评审收尾。目录选择器现在只有一种说法，工具页的「高级」区是一个真正的面板，执行面板的页头也终于按规则描述的方式工作。

修复

  • 目录选择器只有一种说法。 无论出现在哪里，中英文都统一为「选择目录」。
  • 工具页的「高级」区是一个真正的面板。 触发器位于面板标题行，内容填满面板宽度。
  • 执行面板页头重做。 Dismiss 恒渲染且恒在最右；Cancel 降为次要按钮（取消是日常操作，不是破坏性操作）；面板运行时无法被关闭。
  • StrictMode 的双次挂载让运行锁卡死。 热重载之后，应用里每个确认框都是禁用的。
  • 过时提示缺了第四种状态。 现在有加载中、有过时、已最新、失败可重试——检查失败不再渲染成「仍在检查」。
  • 环境变量页与设置页重复了顶栏已经说过的话。 它们的范围徽标已删除；目录上下文只在顶栏出现一次。

1.0.0-beta.13预发布Pre-release2026-09-21

The version management area was rebuilt, and the command echo became what you would actually type.

What's new

  • A version-management region below the tools table. It searches the registry, and once a tool is picked it shows three sections in a fixed order: active, installed, and not installed. The active section carries the upgrade affordance.
  • The main table's action is now a ghost "Manage versions" entry, and an outdated tool shows an upgrade chip instead of a column of its own.
  • The removal vocabulary was settled in ADR-0008: Unuse for a tool, Uninstall for a version, Uninstall for a plugin.

Fixed

  • The command echo became terminal-perspective. A Global-mode echo shows no -C $HOME; a separate line names the working directory instead. The same shape is used by the confirmation dialog.
  • Pasting a Global-mode echo into a project directory means something else for commands without a -g flag — the working-directory line is the disclosure that carries it.

版本管理区重做，命令回显也变成你真正会输入的那一行。

新增

  • 工具表下方新增版本管理区。 它搜索注册表，选中工具后按固定顺序显示三段：已激活、已安装、未安装。已激活段承载升级入口。
  • 主表的操作改为幽灵按钮「版本管理」，过时工具显示升级徽标，而不再单开一列。
  • 移除词汇在 ADR-0008 里定稿：工具用「取消使用」、版本用「卸载」、插件用「卸载」。

修复

  • 命令回显变成终端视角。 全局模式的回显不再带 -C $HOME，改用单独一行说明工作目录。确认框使用同一种形态。
  • 把全局模式的回显粘进项目目录，对没有 -g 参数的命令意味着另一回事——工作目录那一行就是承载这件事的说明。

1.0.0-beta.12预发布Pre-release2026-09-20

A six-pass professional review of the code and the docs, plus a macOS icon fix.

Fixed

  • Six audit passes ran in parallel — docs against code, the zh-CN mirror, code residue, interaction logic, i18n, and doc-internal consistency. All seven tickets are closed.
  • The frontend test baseline entered CI, along with a lint that rejects a stray ellipsis in a button label.
  • Renaming an env var onto an existing one now confirms first, and the Tasks run editor refuses a multi-line run — mise tasks add has no lossless path for one — with an explanation instead of silently flattening it.
  • The i18n lint gained a dead-key guard, so a key that nothing references can no longer survive.
  • The Doctor page got its own missing-mise copy instead of borrowing the Tools page's.

Also

  • The macOS icon was rescaled to a safe area, so it no longer renders larger than every other app in the Dock.

对代码与文档做了六路并行专业评审，另有一处 macOS 图标修复。

修复

  • 六路并行审计——文档对代码、zh-CN 镜像、代码残留、交互逻辑、i18n、文档内部一致性。七个 ticket 全部关闭。
  • 前端测试基线进入 CI，同时新增一条守卫：按钮文案里的多余省略号会被拒绝。
  • 把环境变量改名到已存在的名字，现在先确认；任务运行编辑器拒绝多行 run——mise tasks add 对多行没有无损路径——并给出解释，而不是悄悄压平。
  • i18n 守卫新增死键检查，没有任何地方引用的键不再能存活。
  • 诊断页有了自己的「缺 mise」文案，不再借用工具页的。

另外

  • macOS 图标按安全区重新缩放，不再在 Dock 里显得比别人大一圈。

1.0.0-beta.11预发布Pre-release2026-09-20

The largest batch so far: 26 tickets, and the app grew its first shared components.

What's new

  • One TrustBanner, one SuccessBar, one ListLoading, one Tooltip, one OutdatedHint. Five copies of the same idea became one component each; four pages were reworked around them.
  • A version-management region replaced the old version centre, and the version cell itself became the trigger.
  • The Env and Settings editors gained datalists and an overwrite confirmation.
  • The Tasks page gained create, and a run editor that splits arguments quote-aware.
  • Settings' unset became a danger action with a confirmation, and a setting outside the write scope is disabled with a reason.
  • The Plugins page gained an install form with a live preview of the command it will run.
  • The Doctor page learned "unknown" — a probe that could not run says so instead of claiming the shell is not activated.
  • The frontend gained its first test baseline.

迄今最大的一批：26 个 ticket，应用长出了第一批共享组件。

新增

  • 一个 TrustBanner、一个 SuccessBar、一个 ListLoading、一个 Tooltip、一个 OutdatedHint。 同一个想法的五份拷贝各变成一个组件；四个页面围绕它们重做。
  • 版本管理区取代了旧的版本中心，版本单元格本身成了触发器。
  • 环境变量页与设置页的编辑器加上 datalist 与改名确认。
  • 任务页新增新建，以及按引号规则拆词的运行编辑器。
  • 设置页的「取消设置」变成带确认的破坏性操作，写出范围之外的设置被禁用并给出原因。
  • 插件页新增安装表单，实时预览它将执行的命令。
  • 诊断页学会了「未知」——跑不了的探针会直说，而不是宣称 shell 未激活。
  • 前端有了第一条测试基线。

1.0.0-beta.10预发布Pre-release2026-09-09

The pre-release audit's must-fix batch: failures stopped disappearing, and the copy for "something went wrong, try again" became one thing instead of five.

Fixed

  • A failure that was swallowed now reaches the user. Several error paths ended in silence; they now render their reason and a retry.
  • The error and retry recipes were unified, so the same failure reads the same way on every page.
  • The soft-cancel aftermath was cleaned up: cancelling no longer leaves the page claiming a command is still running.

发版前审计的必修批次：失败不再消失，「出错了，重试」的文案从五处变成一处。

修复

  • 被吞掉的失败现在会到达用户面前。 有几条错误路径以沉默收场；它们现在会说明原因并给出重试。
  • 错误与重试的说法被统一，同一个失败在每个页面读起来都一样。
  • 取消之后的状态收拾干净了：取消后页面不再声称还有命令在运行。

1.0.0-beta.9预发布Pre-release2026-09-08

A typography and lint batch, plus the table work the Tools page needed.

Fixed

  • One OutdatedHint owns the loading, outdated and up-to-date states, so the hint cannot disagree with the badge.
  • A lint now rejects a translation concatenated with + — the class of bug that silently drops a string.
  • Component font sizes moved onto tokens, and a guard keeps them there.
  • One refresh button per page, owned by the page shell instead of copied into it.
  • The Home page compares versions segment by segment, so 2026.10.17 is correctly newer than 2026.9.1.
  • The glyph sweep finished: no caret or triangle markers are left in the UI.
  • Table columns use pixel widths, and the Tools table gained drag-resize, sorting and a text filter.

一批排版与守卫的工作，加上工具页需要的表格能力。

修复

  • 一个 OutdatedHint 负责加载中、有过时、已最新三种状态，提示不会再和徽标互相矛盾。
  • 新增守卫：拒绝与 + 拼接的翻译——这类 bug 会悄悄吞掉一个字符串。
  • 组件字号改用 token，并有守卫守着。
  • 每页只有一个刷新按钮，由页面外壳拥有，而不是各页复制。
  • 首页按段比较版本号，2026.10.17 正确地新于 2026.9.1。
  • 字形清扫收尾：界面里不再残留插入符或三角标记。
  • 表格列改用像素宽度，工具表新增拖拽调宽、排序与文本筛选。

1.0.0-beta.8预发布Pre-release2026-09-07

The caret removal, the collapsed icon rail, and the failure-notice queue.

Fixed

  • Menu triggers lost their carets. Expandability is shown by interaction, not by a ▾.
  • The sidebar collapses to an icon rail and every feature stays reachable there, including the language and theme switches.
  • A rejected command now raises a dismissible notice instead of failing silently, with the same copy on every page.
  • The Home page's RAW output became a disclosure — collapsed by default, one click away, with the copy button intact.

去掉插入符、侧栏收成图标轨道、失败通知队列。

修复

  • 菜单触发器不再带插入符。 可展开由交互体现，而不是一个 ▾。
  • 侧栏可收成图标轨道，每个功能在那里依然可达，包括语言与主题切换。
  • 被拒绝的命令现在会弹出一条可关闭的通知，而不是静默失败，各页文案一致。
  • 首页的原始输出变成一个展开控件——默认折叠，一点即开，复制按钮保留。

1.0.0-beta.7预发布Pre-release2026-09-04

The review batch that reshaped the primitives: one Tooltip with a copy button, fixed table widths, and the Home page's update row.

Fixed

  • One Tooltip primitive replaced every native title — it pops only on a real value, and it carries the copy button.
  • The link-tool path now comes only from the directory picker, so it can never point at a path mise did not report.
  • Command hints were audited so each page lists exactly the commands it can run.
  • Tables got a fixed min-width, so a narrow window scrolls the table instead of crushing its columns.
  • The Home page shows when a newer mise exists and offers the update button.
  • The Doctor page reads the shell activation from the rc file, not from a guess.

重塑基础组件的一轮评审：一个带复制按钮的 Tooltip、固定的表格宽度，以及首页的更新行。

修复

  • 一个 Tooltip 组件取代了所有原生 title——只在真的有值时弹出，并带上复制按钮。
  • 链接工具的路径现在只来自目录选择器，因此它永远不会指向 mise 没有报告过的路径。
  • 命令提示经过审计，每页只列出它真正能执行的命令。
  • 表格有了固定的最小宽度，窄窗口下表格滚动，而不是把列压扁。
  • 首页会提示有更新的 mise，并给出更新按钮。
  • 诊断页从 rc 文件读出 shell 激活状态，不再靠猜。

1.0.0-beta.2预发布Pre-release2026-08-31

这次发布的说明未能按语言拆分，下面是原文。These release notes could not be split by language; the original text follows.

MiseDeck v1.0.0-beta.2

First stable release of MiseDeck, a faithful desktop GUI for mise. Cross-platform (macOS polished, Windows / Linux beta).

What's in v1

  • Global tool management: install, uninstall, switch, upgrade, and see outdated badges in one table.
  • Directory context: resolved tools, env vars, and lockfile previews with config-source badges.
  • Config editor: form-based [tools] and [env] editing for global and per-directory mise.toml.
  • Tasks: list, run with live output, and simple edits.
  • Trust UX: read-only untrusted directories with one-click trust.
  • Settings, doctor, and plugin/backend browsing.
  • mise self-management: guided install when mise is missing and one-click self-update.
  • Activation helpers: open the current directory in a terminal, copy the activation command, and check shell setup.
  • English and Simplified Chinese UI.

English · 简体中文

Install

macOS

（这条 Homebrew 安装命令已经失效：MiseDeck v1 只通过 GitHub Releases 分发。）(This Homebrew command no longer works: MiseDeck v1 ships through GitHub Releases only.)

Or download the .dmg from the assets below, open it, and drag MiseDeck to Applications.

First launch (unsigned): the binary is not notarized (per ADR-0002). macOS Gatekeeper will block the first open and may report that the app is damaged. After dragging misedeck.app to /Applications, remove the quarantine flag from Terminal:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/misedeck.app

Then launch normally. Subsequent launches work without extra steps.

Windows (beta)

Download the .exe installer and run it.

SmartScreen (unsigned): the binary is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen will show "Windows protected your PC" — click More info → Run anyway.

Linux (beta)

Pick the package that matches your distro:

  • .deb — Debian / Ubuntu
  • .rpm — Fedora / RHEL
  • .AppImage — portable, no install

Verify

A SHA256SUMS file is attached below. Verify before installing:

# macOS / Linux
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

# Windows (PowerShell)
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\<file-you-downloaded>

Notes

  • MiseDeck v1 is distributed unsigned on every platform, by design. Code signing and Apple notarization are out of scope for v1.
  • Windows and Linux builds are labeled beta in this release.
  • MiseDeck is a community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the official mise project.
